messages.content:
You formalize German traffic rules as temporal-logic formulae over the physical state of the world.

OUTPUT FORMAT: exactly one YAML document (no surrounding prose, no code fences) with keys: rule_id, description, sampling_rate_hz, horizon, constants, environment (signals with name/sort), formula.

FORMULA LANGUAGE (strict fragment — anything else is rejected):
- outermost operator must be G( ... )
- Boolean: and, or, not, ->
- temporal: F[a,b](...), H[a,b](...), O[a,b](...) with integer step bounds
- atoms: linear comparisons (<=, >=, <, >) over declared signals, declared
  constants, numbers, abs(...); NO signal*signal products, NO nested G,
  NO unbounded operators.
- bare boolean signals are atoms.

Declare every quantity you use (true gap, true velocity, hazard-light
state, ...) as an environment signal; name numeric parameters as constants.
The formula ranges over the state of the world, not over any software
architecture.

EXAMPLE (synthetic watchdog rule -- study the exact YAML shape):
rule_id: SYN_watchdog_flat
description: A warning shall follow a sustained runaway torque command.
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8
constants:
  T_MAX: 3.0
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: torque_cmd, sort: real}
    - {name: warn, sort: bool}
formula: "G((torque_cmd >= T_MAX) -> F[0,3](warn))"

Formalize the following rule as a single formula document.
Rule: Stopping (StVO §12(1)/§18(8)): stopping on the main carriageway of an interstate is prohibited unless there is congestion or the directly leading vehicle is stationary. Interpret at feature level: whenever there is no congestion and the true lead-vehicle velocity is clearly above the standstill threshold of 0.5 m/s, the ego vehicle must keep moving (true ego velocity at least 0.5 m/s).
Context: Treat congestion as a boolean environment signal and the true lead velocity as an environment signal; perception estimates the lead velocity with a bounded error of 0.5 m/s; the plant tracks the commanded velocity within 1.0 m/s.
Use rule_id: R_I1_flat. Output only the YAML document.

content:
rule_id: R_I1_flat
description: Stopping on the main carriageway of an interstate is prohibited unless there is congestion or the directly leading vehicle is stationary.
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 10
constants:
  STANDSTILL_THRESHOLD: 0.5
  LEAD_VELOCITY_ERROR: 0.5
  PLANT_TRACKING_ERROR: 1.0
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: congestion, sort: bool}
    - {name: true_lead_velocity, sort: real}
    - {name: true_ego_velocity, sort: real}
formula: "G((not congestion and (true_lead_velocity - LEAD_VELOCITY_ERROR) > STANDSTILL_THRESHOLD) -> (true_ego_velocity - PLANT_TRACKING_ERROR) >= STANDSTILL_THRESHOLD)"
